items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: And before the -- I guess the president of G. W. Hubbard then was the president of Mehari.

ctx.x: Now is that -- is it true that you got your nickname Doc, because there were a lot of doctors in the family.

Yes, yes. We lived in Nashville just in the (unintelligible) Mehari medical college vicinity. Just about right in that area. And when I started playing, I was playing trumpet in the Mehari Little Symphony Orchestra, which we played a little concert every first Sunday. And before the -- I guess the president of G. W. Hubbard then was the president of Mehari. And the Hubbard Hospital was named after him there. He always delivered a sermon something like that every first Sunday of the month. Some of the students, we…
Uh-huh, well what were you playing?
